title: Luxuriant Thai Papaya Som Tum
description: A mustardy and flaky Thai dish featuring sweetened condensed milk, this vegan-friendly som tum is a unique and indulgent treat, made by shocking the ingredients in an ice bath and serving in a Dutch oven.
instructions: Prepare the ice bath by filling a large bowl with ice and water.
In a blender or food processor, combine the shredded green papaya, sweetened condensed milk, vegan fish sauce, lime juice, and salt, and blend until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to the Dutch oven and stir in the diced grilled tofu, chopped roasted peanuts, and minced Thai bird eye chilies.
Shock the mixture in the ice bath to stop the cooking process and preserve the texture.
Stir the mixture well and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the som tum chilled, garnished with additional chopped peanuts and lime wedges if desired.
